draft_answers_en.one_line: Life Manager is one proactive personal manager for work, money, everyday responsibilities, body, and mind. Its Cloud mode is being built to run continuously for each customer on a dedicated Maritime VM, choose useful work without a daily prompt, verify outcomes, and report them by email. Capafy is the first income-generating workflow.
draft_answers_en.problem: People coordinate work, money, and everyday responsibilities across too many disconnected tools and reminders. Life Manager aims to take initiative on bounded work and return verifiable outcomes.
draft_answers_en.current_status: The public /lm page is live with broad product positioning in English and Japanese. The same-origin /maritime Cloud start route currently returns HTTP 404. Cloud Google login, tenant VM provisioning, and the Capafy work-to-receipt-to-email cycle are not yet verified.
